generator: tools/audio/build_audio7.py (procedural synthesis: sfx7.py; same toolkit + loudness conventions as assets/audio .. audio6)

conventions.contract: CONTRACT_V42 section AM. Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: audio7 (add it to FRAGMENTS in src/core/Assets.js).
conventions.sprite: Every one-shot lives in ONE audio sprite: audioSprite.keys[key] = [start s, duration s] with 50 ms gaps; Assets.queueAudio loads it once ('__sprite_audio7') and Assets.sliceSprite cuts one AudioBuffer per key (dur + 30 ms) into the audio cache, so Audio.play(key) / exists(key) work unchanged. This manifest is the sprite's JSON (3 files in all).
conventions.groups: Audio.play('sfx_typewriter') / Audio.play('sfx_coin_sack') pick a random variant (never the same twice in a row); the group names are also playable keys (variant 1).
conventions.levels: volume = 10^((target + HEADROOM_DB - measured) / 20), measured on the decoded sprite slice (max momentary LUFS) / the decoded loop (integrated LUFS); HEADROOM_DB = -2 like audio .. audio6.

sfx_typewriter.notes: a clerk types (desk_type + typewriter overlay): four soft key clacks. Play the group 'sfx_typewriter' (random variant, never the same twice) every 0.55-0.8 s while desk_type plays, volume by distance / reveal; sfx_typewriter_3 ends a line with the margin bell.

sfx_typewriter_3.notes: variant ending on the tiny margin bell 'ting' (F6) - end of a line (group sfx_typewriter, or play it alone every 3-4 bursts).

sfx_switch_clack.notes: the spring turnout lever ('철컥') when the loop switch is thrown for the train, by distance.

sfx_wheel_squeal.notes: gentle flange squeal while a car runs on a loop curve, very quiet. Silent at both ends: loop the sliced buffer (sm.add('sfx_wheel_squeal', {loop: true})) or retrigger every 1.2 s while the train is on the curve; volume x speed / max speed; rate 0.95-1.05 per car so two cars never line up.

sfx_mailbox_flag.notes: office_mailbox: the flag flips up when a letter arrives (tin clack + tiny bell C7); also when a clerk empties it.

sfx_coin_sack.notes: the courier 딸랑이 scoops the tills / swings the sack: play the group 'sfx_coin_sack' on each scoop and every ~1.5 s of carry_sack walking (soft, x0.6); muffled coins + her bell pin 'ttallang-ttallang'.

sfx_coin_sack_3.notes: variant: a fuller sack (group sfx_coin_sack) - use for the hand_over at the bank counter.

amb_office.notes: inside the 촌장 사무실 (24 s mono loop, texture only): soft typing from two desks, page turns, a pen, the kettle simmering on the stove, the wall clock ticking once a second. setAmbience('amb_office', reveal 0..1) while the office is revealed / the camera is near it (like amb_bank). The contract's -26 LUFS is its level at full reveal (6.5 dB above amb_bank: the office is a small, busy room); duck it to ~0.6 under the panel.
